parameters.name: current_limit
parameters.doc: Battery-side current limit, both motors summed (s4.7.4 item 1)

parameters.name: block_window
parameters.doc: Averaging block of the 10 Hz current log (s4.7.4 item 1)

parameters.name: flight_valid
parameters.doc: 1 when the flight is legal; 0 for a rule breach the simulator cannot see (lost part, flight-zone breach, failed static test)

parameters.name: flight_clock_throttle_up
parameters.doc: Flight time starts at throttle-up (current > 5 A or 5 km/h), so the 60 s climb includes the ground roll (s4.6.4-4.6.5)

terms.name: flight_ok
terms.expr: if(peak_voltage <= 12.75 V && peak_current <= 70 A && takeoff_distance <= announced_takeoff, 1, 0) * flight_valid

reference_field.name: s_raw_best
reference_field.note: ASSUMPTION: best raw score of the round is unknown before the event; default 10 cans (3.5 kg) x (3138 m)^2 from AeroUD ACC2026 report 09 (competitions.md s2.3, 10 cans, 3.138 km). Set to the field best.

variants.description: v1.3 text: S_raw = B_to m d^2 (1 - P_current), P_current = min(1, 0.002 * integral(max(0, I - 30 A)) dt) (eq. 2 and 6)

Pre-v1.3 reading (change-log 2026-06-27): S_raw = B_to m d^2 - 2 * integral(max(0, I - 30 A)) dt; superseded, shipped for reproducing earlier analyses. The penalty is subtracted in kg*m^2 as printed, so it is numerically negligible against 1e7 kg*m^2.
